cases.provenance_note: Unmodified original CaptureNextFrame output; native and shim-injected producers verify 12 frames each against CPU byte oracles. Marker images do not establish resource equality; mandatory boundary hashes and hardware/WARP tests do. Explicit context snapshot omitted; immediate context recovered from checked Map READ/Unmap evidence. Original player Open fails. This is a retained capture-omission control.
cases.device_scope: Producer uses local hardware; generic original player adapter/configuration unidentified.
